name: Kusakabe Nagisa
source:
Akisuke's classmate. she had a serious illness when she was a child, and she was hospitalized for a whole year and couldn't go to school, so she was one year older than my classmate Akisuke. She has excellent grades and is a class representative and secretary of the Students' Union. Strong spirit and high pride. With a cool personality, he usually tends to give a cold impression to others. Though she thinks the hero is an unreliable boy, for some reason she can't leave Akisuke alone, and every time she talks to him. Contrary to the serious and straightforward atmosphere, she like ecchi (large.)

[From Getchu]
